answer: Require every new identity to lock a slashable bond and complete a small live task whose input is bound to its kernel at registration. Verified work grows reputation like a tended garden, while a relic account with no recent proof earns nothing. Making 10,000 fakes means locking 10,000 bonds and doing 10,000 real tasks; one detected cluster slashes all linked bonds, so scale multiplies cost and loss instead of profit.
